title: Weird
style: Chamber-pop, intimate vocal in a close, natural delivery; unhurried brushed pulse; soft tape saturation; soft piano, muted strings, and brushed drums.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
We came in through the tunnel
Sand still in the seams of our clothes
Vicky and Pilar already at the table
Ordinary questions in a quiet room

“How are you feeling?”
She looked at her plate a second too long
Then said the only word that fit
“Weird.”

[Pre-Chorus]
Years of not naming it
Erika never gave it a shape
Ambiguity was the softest place to rest
Now the label sits heavy on the chest

[Chorus]
It’s weird
When the thing that used to be free
Suddenly has a name
And everyone can see
It’s weird
How a word can turn comfort into weight
How the same love feels different
Once it’s stated

[Verse 2]
Glances across the table
Aurora and Vicky trading what the men can’t read
Yes, these past few days
No, not yet
And Pilar stays unreadable

Later in the guest-wing living room
Lighter talk on the surface
Vicky and Thomas half-embraced on the couch
Like the label hasn’t reached them yet

[Chorus]
It’s weird
When the thing that used to be free
Suddenly has a name
And everyone can see
It’s weird
How a word can turn comfort into weight
How the same love feels different
Once it’s stated

[Bridge]
A little after ten
He stands, excuses himself
Extends one arm toward Aurora
The private current shifts again

She takes a minute
Then follows
Leaving the half-embrace
And the newly named thing
Behind them in the light

[Final Chorus]
It’s weird
When the thing that used to be free
Suddenly has a name
And everyone can see
It’s weird
But some nights you just carry it
Quietly
And let the room keep its secrets

[Outro]
Weird
That’s all she said
And somehow
It was enough
